title: SpatialCore — Development Roadmap
summary: Phased roadmap for extracting SpatialCore from OpenSpatialDelay, publishing it publicly, and building future plugins on it.
notes: Roadmap with goals, phases, and deliverable checklists → PRD-style scope/requirements. Contains a frozen SpatializationAlgorithm interface snippet (SPEC signal) and a 'Critical Design Rules' list stated as locked (ADR-like), but neither uses Status/Decision/Consequences structure and both are restatements of rules recorded elsewhere. Dominant signal is planned scope and deliverables → PRD.
